# Typographist

> Symbolic typography and soft hyphenation for JavaScript and TypeScript, with a standalone ESM core and React, Vue and Solid integrations.

Use this library to format plain display text with locale-specific signs and
nonbreaking characters. It does not parse or sanitize HTML, correct user errors,
or reformat numbers and currencies. Retain original text for editing and storage.

Built-in profiles: en, ru, es, fr, de, pt (Brazilian baseline), it, and zh
(Simplified Chinese symbols without soft hyphens). Language selection is explicit;
regional fallback is not automatic. Reuse an instance or framework provider.

## Application integration

- [Agent guide](https://elmenov-softworks.github.io/typographist/packages/typographist/AGENT_GUIDE.md): Package selection, defaults, locale mapping, rendering and common mistakes. Start here.
- [Core guide](https://elmenov-softworks.github.io/typographist/packages/typographist/README.md): Configuration, cache, protection, custom locales and limitations.
- [Examples](https://elmenov-softworks.github.io/typographist/packages/typographist/EXAMPLES.md): Plain text, multilingual display, disabled consumers, SSR and copying.
- [React guide](https://elmenov-softworks.github.io/typographist/packages/typographist-react/README.md): Provider, leaf component and string hook.
- [Vue guide](https://elmenov-softworks.github.io/typographist/packages/typographist-vue/README.md): Composition API, provider, leaf component and computed ref.
- [Solid guide](https://elmenov-softworks.github.io/typographist/packages/typographist-solid/README.md): Provider, leaf component and accessor hook.

## Optional

- [Locale baselines](https://elmenov-softworks.github.io/typographist/packages/typographist/locale-rules/README.md): Data provenance, licenses and linguistic limitations.
- [Rules converter](https://elmenov-softworks.github.io/typographist/packages/rules-transformer/README.md): Convert TeX hyphenation data for a custom locale.
- [API reference](https://elmenov-softworks.github.io/typographist/): Generated TypeDoc reference.
